title: 第12章 原始森林
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦守陷入深深的自我怀疑。

我真的帅到丧心病狂吗？

陆小小她们开玩笑就算了，怎么姜瑶也被我英俊的外貌给折服了？

美女班长性格要强，她能当众说出这一番话，只能说明一个问题——我太帅了！

秦守甚至没心思关注聊天频道里的消息，目光瞥向车窗里自己的倒影。

还真是啊，越看越帅！

姜瑶坐在秦守右边，脊背挺得笔直，假装在认真看屏幕。

但她余光扫过秦守的侧脸时，正好捕捉到他对着车窗倒影微微扬起的嘴角，以及他眼神中的自我陶醉。

她的眉梢轻轻跳了一下。

这家伙，该不会真以为他长得很帅吧？

以前怎么没发现他这么自恋！

姜瑶的耳尖莫名红，娇艳欲滴。

“咳。”姜瑶清了清嗓子，声音不自觉地比平时高了小半个调，“秦守，聊天频道里有新情况，别照镜子了。”

秦守回过神来，对上的不是姜瑶的视线，而是她微微的侧脸和抿成一条线的嘴唇。

秦守识趣地收回目光，把注意力转向屏幕。

众女生的反应很微妙。

她们看了看姜瑶，又看了看秦守。

总感觉班长和秦守之间有点微妙啊！

陆小小嘻嘻笑着想说些什么，被林雪儿拦住了。

林雪儿轻声道：“小小，快看，聊天频道里又有新状况。”

果不其然，聊天频道里的风向变了。

之前全是“找到吃的了”“活下来了”的欢呼，现在变成了一个个炫耀帖子。

【哈哈，我获得了木头×5，系统提示是基础物资，可以用来建造各种物品，甚至还可以用来升级地铁。】

【我获得了石头×3，同样是基础物资，以后也可以用来升级地铁！】

【我获得了干草×10！】

【这算什么，我捡到了一张初级蓝图「简易石斧」！用木头×5，石头×3就能造一柄石斧，砍木头效率大大提升！】

【我也有蓝图！「简易石镐」，挖石头效率也大大提升！】

【「简易石矛」！有了这个终于不用赤手空拳了！】

【「简易木盾」！虽然只是木板绑在一起的，但防御力还算不错。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Shou fell into deep self-doubt.

Am I really insanely handsome?

Even if Lu Xiaoxiao and the others were joking, why was Jiang Yao also impressed by my handsome appearance?

The beautiful squad leader has a strong personality. The fact that she can say this in public can only mean one thing - I am so handsome!

Qin Shou didn't even bother to pay attention to the news in the chat channel, and glanced at his reflection in the car window.

It’s true, the more you look at it, the more handsome it becomes!

Jiang Yao sat on the right side of Qin Shou, with her back straight and pretending to look at the screen seriously.

But when she glanced at Qin Shou's profile with her peripheral vision, she happened to catch the corners of his mouth slightly raised at the reflection in the car window, as well as the narcissism in his eyes.

The tip of her eyebrows jumped slightly.

This guy, don't you really think he's handsome?

Why didn't I realize he was so narcissistic before?

The tips of Jiang Yao's ears were inexplicably red, and she was so pretty.

"Cough." Jiang Yao cleared her throat, her voice unconsciously raised half a tone higher than usual, "Qin Shou, there is something new in the chat channel, please stop looking in the mirror."

When Qin Shou came back to his senses, what he saw was not Jiang Yao's gaze, but her slightly profiled face and pursed lips.

Qin Shou wisely withdrew his gaze and turned his attention to the screen.

The reactions of the girls were very subtle.

They looked at Jiang Yao and then at Qin Shou.

I always feel that there is something subtle between the squad leader and Qin Shou!

Lu Xiaoxiao was laughing and wanted to say something, but Lin Xueer stopped him.

Lin Xueer said softly: "Xiaoxiao, look, there is a new situation in the chat channel."

Sure enough, the trend in the chat channel changed.

What used to be all cheers of "I found something to eat" and "I survived" have now turned into posts showing off.

[Haha, I got wood x 5. The system prompts that it is a basic material that can be used to build various items and even upgrade the subway.】

[I got 3 stones, which are also basic materials and can be used to upgrade the subway in the future!】

【I got hay x10!】

[What does this mean? I picked up a basic blueprint "Simple Stone Ax"!Using wood x 5 and stone x 3, you can make a stone axe, which greatly improves the efficiency of cutting wood!】

【I also have a blueprint!"Simple Stone Pickaxe" greatly improves the efficiency of digging stones!】

["Simple stone spear"!With this, I finally don’t have to use my bare hands!】

["Simple wooden shield"!Although it's just wooden boards tied together, its defense is pretty good.】
